import asyncio
async def run(items, op):
    for item in items:
        try:
            await op(item)
        finally:
            log(item)
    while more():
        match await read():
            case value: use(value)
    for item in items:
        result = (await op(item), item)
    for item in items:
        async with lock(item):
            use(item)
